original_text:
The Golden Rule
Follow all instructions given by the lab manager and/or supervisors.
explanation: This page introduces the single most important rule in the laboratory, termed 'The Golden Rule'. It requires individuals to follow all instructions provided by the lab manager and/or supervisors without exception.

questions.q: According to the slide, what is 'The Golden Rule' of lab safety?
opts: Always wear a lab coat and gloves
Keep your workspace clean and organized
Follow all instructions given by the lab manager and/or supervisors
Report all minor accidents at the end of the class period
questions.exp: The slide explicitly defines 'The Golden Rule' as: 'Follow all instructions given by the lab manager and/or supervisors.'
